title: Fairness or Fluency? An Investigation into Language Bias of Pairwise LLM-as-a-Judge
reasoning: The paper investigates performance disparities and language bias using the MMMLU benchmark, which includes subjects such as philosophy, ethics, and law. It explicitly analyzes how bias is more pronounced in these culturally and socially grounded subjects and provides a detailed example in Appendix E.3 concerning the 'doctrine of double effect' and whether actions are 'morally permissible' to demonstrate its methodology.
